subject: literacy
concept: Comparing a work of world literature to its adaptation in another medium (film, stage) and analyzing creative choices
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a described scene in text form to a described adaptation of the same scene and notes changes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an adaptation change to a plausible creative reason behind it
exercise.abstract: Student analyzes a specific creative choice made in adapting a literary work and evaluates its effect

misconception_flags: treats every adaptation change as an error rather than considering it as a deliberate creative choice

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
